title: /workloads/{id}/mode — configuration field
bodyMarkdown:
## Purpose

`online` resolves fresh and cannot have a snapshot. `offline` uses only eligible local/static inputs and cannot set `audit_required`. `hybrid` may use an approved static snapshot only for qualifying unavailable failures. Denial, TLS/trust failure, malformed data, and expiry do not authorize fallback.

## Constraints and authority

Public schema path: `/workloads/{id}/mode`. allowed alternatives: ["offline", "online", "hybrid"]. Branch-specific requirements and native permission/identity checks still apply; schema input acceptance alone is not authority. Use synthetic declarations in the preview and keep credential bytes outside policy.

## Expected result

The local proposal contains the intended declaration and passes complete-policy validation. Browser Save retains a local draft; it does not activate native configuration, fetch a provider value or grant remote access. Use the corresponding guide for actual native operations.

## Recovery

On invalid or unsupported combinations, retain the preceding accepted document, correct the relevant declaration and validate again. Read/plan locally before running; do not change identity or destination to bypass a denial.
capabilityStatus: A declared configuration field; browser editing is local. Actual native behavior depends on the selected schema/runtime, adapter and authorization.
